entities.name: Muggtoth
entities.description: A zombie cyclops from Dominaria who could foresee his potential death; killed by Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker who emerged from a time rift and killed Muggtoth and Vissk with ghostfire.

entities.name: Vissk
entities.description: Person who had seen Muggtoth in a vision of the future.

entities.name: Pinaphet
entities.description: Vissk's apprentice who gave Muggtoth an antidote.

entities.name: Viperwick pollen
entities.description: Poison that slowly and painfully afflicted Muggtoth.

events.summary: Muggtoth, suffering from Viperwick pollen poisoning, meets Vissk, who had seen him in a vision.
events.quote: he encountered Vissk , who had seen Muggtoth in a vision of the future.

events.summary: Pinaphet gives Muggtoth an antidote that relieves some pain.
events.quote: He had his apprentice Pinaphet give him an antidote which relieved some pain.

events.summary: A time rift opens and Ugin kills Muggtoth and Vissk with ghostfire; Muggtoth dies at peace.
events.quote: a time rift opened revealing Ugin , who killed Muggtoth and Vissk with ghostfire .
